x_scaled = 0.5 * x1  # multiply every sample by 0.5, halving the amplitude

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 3))
plt.plot(t, x1, label="x1")
plt.plot(t, x_scaled, label="0.5 * x1")
plt.title("Scaling amplitude")
plt.xlabel("Time (s)")
plt.ylabel("Amplitude")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

clips.caption: Scaling multiplies every <emphasis level="strong">sample</emphasis> by the same constant. Times 0.5 halves the <emphasis level="strong">amplitude</emphasis> and keeps the shape. Note this scales the amplitude, not time.
